items.q: An exterior angle of a triangle is 120°. One non-adjacent interior angle is 50°. What is the other non-adjacent interior angle?
items.qAf: ’n Buitehoek van ’n driehoek is 120°. Een nie-aanliggende binnehoek is 50°. Wat is die ander nie-aanliggende binnehoek?
items.explain: An exterior angle equals the sum of the two non-adjacent interior angles: 120° − 50° = 70°.
items.explainAf: ’n Buitehoek is gelyk aan die som van die twee nie-aanliggende binnehoeke: 120° − 50° = 70°.

items.q: Triangle ABC has AB = AC and ∠A = 40°. What is ∠B?
items.qAf: Driehoek ABC het AB = AC en ∠A = 40°. Wat is ∠B?

items.q: Triangle 1 has sides 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm. Triangle 2 has sides 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm. Which statement is true?
items.qAf: Driehoek 1 het sye 3 cm, 4 cm en 5 cm. Driehoek 2 het sye 6 cm, 8 cm en 10 cm. Watter stelling is waar?
options: Every side of triangle 2 is double the matching side of triangle 1
The triangles are not similar because their angles differ
The triangles are similar, but only their angles are equal
optionsAf: Every side of triangle 2 is double the matching side of triangle 1
The triangles are not similar because their angles differ
The triangles are similar, but only their angles are equal
items.explain: Each side of triangle 2 is 2 times the matching side of triangle 1, so the triangles are similar.
items.explainAf: Elke sy van driehoek 2 is 2 keer die ooreenstemmende sy van driehoek 1, dus is die driehoeke soortgelyk.

items.q: Which quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
items.qAf: Watter vierhoek het presies een paar ewewydige sye?
items.explain: A trapezium has exactly one pair of parallel sides.
items.explainAf: ’n Trapesium het presies een paar ewewydige sye.

items.q: Two adjacent angles of a parallelogram are x and 3x. Find the smaller angle.
items.qAf: Twee aanliggende hoeke van ’n parallelogram is x en 3x. Vind die kleiner hoek.
items.explain: Adjacent angles add to 180°: 4x = 180, so x = 45°.
items.explainAf: Aanliggende hoeke tel op tot 180°: 4x = 180, dus x = 45°.

items.q: The diagonals of a quadrilateral bisect each other and are equal in length. What is the quadrilateral?
items.qAf: Die hoeklyne van ’n vierhoek halveer mekaar en is gelyk in lengte. Watter vierhoek is dit?
items.explain: Equal diagonals that bisect each other describe a rectangle.
items.explainAf: Gelyke hoeklyne wat mekaar halveer, beskryf ’n reghoek.
